name: nimanto
description: An evidence-first, candidate-controlled job search and application workbench for H-1B professionals.
author: Umang Dhawan

scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @nimanto/api dev" "pnpm --filter @nimanto/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @nimanto/web dev"
scripts.sbom:check: env -u NODE_PATH node node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/bin/cdxgen.js -t js --exclude '.claude/**' --no-install-deps --profile license-compliance --spec-version 1.6 --format cyclonedx -o /tmp/nimanto.cdx.json . && node scripts/sanitize-sbom.mjs /tmp/nimanto.cdx.json && node scripts/validate-sbom.mjs /tmp/nimanto.cdx.json
scripts.sbom:release: env -u NODE_PATH node node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/bin/cdxgen.js -t js --exclude '.claude/**' --no-install-deps --profile license-compliance --spec-version 1.6 --json-pretty --format cyclonedx -o docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.cdx.json . && env -u NODE_PATH node node_modules/@cyclonedx/cdxgen/bin/cdxgen.js -t js --exclude '.claude/**' --no-install-deps --profile license-compliance --json-pretty --format spdx -o docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.spdx.json . && node scripts/sanitize-sbom.mjs docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.cdx.json docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.spdx.json && prettier --write docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.cdx.json docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.spdx.json && node scripts/validate-sbom.mjs docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.cdx.json docs/releases/nimanto-v0.4.2.spdx.json
scripts.start:all: concurrently --kill-others --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @nimanto/api start" "pnpm --filter @nimanto/worker start" "pnpm --filter @nimanto/web start"
